zh-HK: KPI Cut Off Day 統一為報表日，所有 MTD、季度及年度數據使用前一個曆日作實際截止日，並支援跨月及跨年
月尾報表日會正確計算季度剩餘工作日及月份；2026-09-01 報表日以 2026-08-31 截止，只計 9 月 22 個工作日及 1 個月
NB 分析同時顯示報表日與數據截止日；變更日期會即時重算 Sales、Margin、M0／M1-M5 及帳戶數
en: KPI Cut Off Day now consistently represents the report date; MTD, quarterly, and annual data use the previous calendar day as the actual cutoff, including cross-month and cross-year transitions
Month-end report dates now calculate quarterly remaining workdays and months correctly; report date 2026-09-01 uses cutoff 2026-08-31 and counts only September with 22 workdays and one month
NB analysis shows both report date and data cutoff, and date changes immediately recalculate Sales, Margin, M0/M1-M5, and account counts
